page.overview:
Who is Arab Beauty 2?

This Arab Beauty was an unnamed woman who appeared briefly in the 1977 James Bond film The Spy Who Loved Me. She was portrayed by Anika Pavel.

This woman is a member of Sheikh Hosein's harem. When Hosein and Bond talk about business, she has to leave the tent together with the other girls.
